k02.text: ...Fair point. But I don't think it's him.

k04.text: There's a study where women who weren't sure a guy liked them were the most into him. Small, college students. Don't quote me.

k08.text: Hoping isn't dumb. Apparently couples do better when they see the best in each other.

k09.text: ...Then you're drawing a nice picture of someone who isn't there.

k10.text: I don't think she wants him. I think she wants to be picked by him.

k12.text: She hasn't checked her phone once.

a01.text: Top of her class. Eleven drafts to say 'hey'.

a04.text: She flips it over like a lottery ticket.

a05.text: So she's hooked on not knowing.

a10.text: That's the girl. She looks okay.

p03.text: Everyone likes you. It's weird you picked me.

p04.text: He's really there, when he's there.

p09.text: He sat with me till two a.m. before my presentation.

p10.text: He never asked how it went.

p11.text: In all of these, he's asking me how it went.

p12.text: I keep drawing a guy who asks.

p13.text: I wrote eleven drafts to someone who doesn't exist.

m03.text: He's on time for the voice note.

m07.text: I know. You told me. Twice.

r01.text: I know, I know. Thursday. I'll be so on time it'll be insulting.

r02.text: Don't look at me. I'm a hallucination brought on by revision.

r03.text: Straight cuts are for people who've given up. You said.

r04.text: You go quiet right before you get brilliant.

r05.text: I didn't pick you. You were the only one in the library making that face.

n01.text: Potential never disappoints. It never cancels. It lives in a future where you wrote the ending.

n02.text: You're not waiting for their reply. You're waiting to feel chosen.
